Definition: from G5521; to be bilious, i.e. (by implication) irritable (enraged, "choleric"):--be angry.
BiblicalUsage: Cholao is to be angry, to boil with rage, and it stands once in the words of Jesus at the feast. He asks the Jews whether they are angry at Him because He made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day, as if healing were a crime.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that anger at a healing shows a heart that loves its rules more than its neighbour.
